mapper.sql: id,vehicle_type,max_load,license_number,vehicle_latitude,vehicle_longitude,current_action_code,status,version,route_id,segment_index,segment_progress,position_at,CASE WHEN deleted_at IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM vehicle ORDER BY id
SELECT FROM vehicle WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE vehicle SET vehicle_type=#{typeCode},max_load=#{maxLoad},license_number=#{licenseNumber},vehicle_latitude=#{currentLatitude},vehicle_longitude=#{currentLongitude},current_action_code=#{currentAction} WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE vehicle SET deleted_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),status='INACTIVE' WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE vehicle SET status='ASSIGNED' WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status='AVAILABLE'
UPDATE vehicle SET vehicle_latitude=#{latitude},vehicle_longitude=#{longitude},position_at=#{positionAt},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND version=#{version}
UPDATE vehicle SET status=#{status},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT v.id,v.vehicle_latitude AS current_latitude,v.vehicle_longitude AS current_longitude,v.version, f.factory_latitude AS target_latitude,f.factory_longitude AS target_longitude FROM vehicle v JOIN trans_task t ON t.active_vehicle_id=v.id AND t.status IN ('ASSIGNED','IN_PROGRESS') JOIN need n ON n.id=t.need_id AND n.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN factory f ON f.id=n.factory_id AND f.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE v.deleted_at IS NULL AND v.status IN ('ASSIGNED','LOADING','TRANSPORTING','UNLOADING')
